evidence_review.raw_geometry_cache_valid: No body feedback; raw histories are deterministic actual input/ray outputs. Runner checks current points, eligible masks, event/static masks and historical timestamps and reproduces all baseline decisions/publications. It does not hash each historical KD tree.
evidence_review.projected_depth_limitation: A transforms frozen historical world points to the current sensor pose. These are actual sampled coordinates but not current actual lidar returns or two independent historical ray measurements. A repeats foreground relative to one fixed startup map; B uses the same point source.
evidence_review.unknown_world_novelty_limitation: Missing ray correspondence yields foreground0. A nonempty frozen world KD tree can still yield novelty1 in an uncovered new area; world novelty is not motion evidence.
evidence_review.reference_gap_diagnostic: On observation reset, reference_front_history is not cleared. A post-gap first observation can log reference_startup=true using a pre-gap fraction, but ordinary3 blocks publication; by the third consecutive actual observation stale entries have fallen out. No frozen runtime source was edited.
evidence_review.timing: All methods recompute actual DepthFrame/point_events; raw density-peak/NN and frozen-view features are shared once. composed_offline_step_ms adds shared geometry/features to each method measured component. The baseline also pays unused reference feature cost. These are concurrent offline composed estimates, not standalone ROS callback p95, CPU budget or backlog proof.
evidence_review.counter: reference_supplement_only in frame logs counts candidate acceptances before frozen publication suppression; it is not an actual published-box count.

validation.scope: Implementation/API checks only; old142/static467/four outputs/ROS runtime joint gates remain unmeasured.

caution: Cumulative boxes are a false-positive proxy; no physical false-positive annotations or closed-loop safety proof. Unmeasured gates are null, never zero/pass.

completed_combination_miss_diagnosis.scope: Post-hoc only; candidates near labels are not proof of object identity.

negative_sampling_regression.limitation: Constructed visible first-return input and physically valid route with a fixed sphere; startup synthetic scan preseeded. Not hardware data, startup acquisition timing or false-positive frequency. Earlier straight-route prefixes cross the screen and are not the authoritative negative regression.

two_history_plane_source_screen.limitation: Candidate-level static explanation; does not establish the hypothetical moving candidate passed all startup evidence. No V exception or production change.

delivered_source_note.changes_after_complete_algorithm: Clarify projected historical samples and ray-unknown vs world-novel; add assertion that a nonempty world map can yield novelty1 when ray is unknown. No detector behavior changed.
